ValidationRule.description: R-RC6 and the person reference convention: a receipt names a Contact or an Account, never both and never neither. A receipt reconciled from a consumed number carries no donor, so the rule reads issued receipts only (R-RC3).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(Status__c) = "Issued", OR( AND( ISBLANK(Donor_Contact__c), ISBLANK(Donor_Account__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Donor_Contact__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Donor_Account__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A receipt names one donor: either a person or an organization, not both and not neither.
